sections.title: Current positions

entries.title: Principal Scientist — Wageningen Food Safety Research (WFSR)
entries.details: Appointed as one of four Principal Scientists at WFSR, alongside the role of Head of Data Science & AI. The role focuses on developing an institute-wide scientific vision and advancing research.

entries.title: Head of Data Science & Artificial Intelligence — Wageningen Food Safety Research (WFSR)
entries.details: Leads an international, interdisciplinary team of 25 researchers. Responsible for scientific direction, team development, acquisition, project leadership and coordination, and the development of AI for food-safety research and statutory tasks. Leads and contributes to European research consortia and collaborations with EFSA, FAO and the Netherlands Food and Consumer Product Safety Authority (NVWA).

entries.title: Member, Advisory Group on Data (AGoD) — European Food Safety Authority (EFSA)
entries.details: Member of the Innovation subgroup, advising EFSA on emerging data-science and AI directions and their responsible use in food safety risk assessment and surveillance.

sections.title: Past positions

entries.title: Principal Investigator, Explainable AI for Oncology — UMC Utrecht
entries.details: Principal investigator at assistant professor level, leading research on explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) in oncology. Projects covered lymphoma, breast, kidney and prostate cancer, in collaboration with medical oncologists, haematologists, radiation oncologists, radiologists, epidemiologists, and experts in medical image acquisition and AI-based image analysis.

entries.title: Supervising Researcher — Prinses Máxima Center for Pediatric Oncology
entries.details: Supervised PhD research on deep learning-based assessment of Wilms tumour and sarcoma in children.

entries.title: Postdoctoral Researcher — UMC Utrecht
entries.details: Deep learning for breast MRI response monitoring and multi-centre harmonisation of quantitative imaging biomarkers.

entries.title: PhD Researcher, Medical Imaging — Utrecht University / UMC Utrecht
entries.details: Pioneered automated analysis of four-dimensional breast MRI, identifying a perfusion biomarker in the healthy contralateral breast that can predict response to chemotherapy and hormonal therapy. Supervisors: Prof. Max Viergever and Dr. Kenneth Gilhuijs.

entries.title: Research Fellow — Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center, New York, USA
entries.details: Validated the automated breast MRI biomarker in an independent patient cohort at Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center. Collaboration with Prof. Elizabeth Morris and Dr. Elizabeth Sutton resulted in multiple peer-reviewed publications and conference contributions.

entries.title: Graduation Internship — Radboud UMC
entries.details: Machine learning for segmentation of multiple sclerosis lesions on brain MRI. Supervised by Dr. Bram Platel and Prof. Nico Karssemeijer.

entries.title: Research Fellow — UC Berkeley, California, USA
entries.details: Biomedical image-analysis research in Prof. Martin Banks's laboratory, resulting in a peer-reviewed publication and conference poster.

entries.title: Board Member & Consultant — UniPartners Eindhoven
